caseNameFull: Sanchez-Llamas v. Oregon Bustillo v. Johnson, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections

opinions.text:
*1001Sup. Ct. Ore.; and *1002Sup. Ct. Va. Motion of petitioner in No. 04-10566 for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari in No. 04-10566 granted limited to Questions 1 and 2 presented by the petition. Certiorari in No. 05-51 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

No. 05-51.
